## Report

Path of the change report with the evidence: `openspec/changes/<change>/reports/...`

## Checklist

- [ ] The specification was updated before the code
- [ ] The failing test existed before the implementation
- [ ] `docs/` is updated in this same change
- [ ] No key, no token and no real customer data is included
- [ ] No commercially licensed font file is included
- [ ] No `Co-Authored-By` trailer
